meta.name: dot-ai-prds-get
meta.description: Fetch all open GitHub issues from this project that have the 'PRD' label

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 获取项目所有带PRD标签的GitHub议题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要从GitHub仓库中快速筛选出PRD相关的议题。
copy.tagline_en: Fetch all open GitHub issues with PRD label from a project
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly filter PRD-related issues from a GitHub repository.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以获取当前 GitHub 项目中所有标记为“PRD”的开放议题，并按用途分类展示，同时给出优先级分析和下一步建议。
howto.when: 当用户要求查看项目的 PRD 列表或询问产品需求时触发。

say.text: 列出这个项目所有带 PRD 标签的议题。
say.note: Claude 会获取并展示 PRD 列表。

say.text: 帮我分析一下这些 PRD 的优先级。
say.note: Claude 会进行优先级分析。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude can fetch all open GitHub issues labeled 'PRD' from the current project, categorize them by purpose, and provide priority analysis and next-step suggestions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to view PRD issues or requests product requirement information.

say_en.text: List all issues with the PRD label in this project.
say_en.note: Claude will fetch and display the PRD list.

say_en.text: Analyze the priorities of these PRDs.
